[NDET.2.5] **The `backends` entries.** An engine registers the seven backings
of [NSBK.6.1] and no other ([NSBK.2.3]), so its `backends` list must be exactly
these entries, in this order:

| Slot | Entry |
|---|---|
| 0 | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma:ds-welford-ewma:0.1.0` |
| 1 | `SeriesBackendMonotonicDeque:ds-monotonic-deque:0.1.0` |
| 2 | `SeriesBackendFifoDeque:ds-fifo-deque:0.1.0` |
| 3 | `SeriesBackendReservoir:ds-reservoir:0.1.0` |
| 4 | `SeriesBackendIntervalPulse:ds-interval-pulse:0.1.0` |
| 5 | `SeriesBackendNumericIntegral:ds-numeric-integral:0.1.0` |
| 6 | `SeriesBackendRingBuffer:ds-ring-buffer:1.0.0` |

The names and versions are provenance ([NDET.2.1]). A backend's version must
change whenever what it answers changes, and that waits for a minor bump
([NSBK.7.1]).
